name: `main.rs`
summary: App, 120 Hz fixed tick, Avian (8 substeps), plugins

name: `motion/donor.rs`
summary: GLB parse (gltf crate): hierarchy, skin joints, curves

name: `motion/retarget.rs`
summary: Donor clips → canonical UAL2 skeleton (name copy / Mixamo bind-delta)

name: `motion/extract.rs`
summary: Dense clip → tagged extreme keys

name: `motion/timing.rs`
summary: Stylized timing: holds, snaps, stepping on twos, exaggeration

name: `motion/bank.rs`
summary: `PoseBank`: tracks, masks, `assets/anim/poses.json` overrides (hot reload)

name: `motion/rig.rs`
summary: Spawn model on `ModelRequest`, bind bones → `Rig`

name: `motion/secondary.rs`
summary: Per-bone angular springs, arm world inertia + acceleration trail (`Arm swing` knob), chest/neck/head nod against vertical acceleration, impulses, squash

name: `motion/body.rs`
summary: Body capsules (+ the root's `BodyPadding` for worn armour); swings arms out of torso/head/opposite thigh and thighs apart (after springs, before contact)

name: `motion/contact.rs`
summary: Foot IK (heel + ball), pelvis drop only as far as a planted foot can't reach by straightening its leg (swing feet ignored), step-bounce dip (`ContactRequest.bob`, fades where the feet stand at different heights), COP lean, look-at, hand IK

name: `motion/hand.rs`
summary: Hand rig: `Grip` (`Cylinder` handle / lever / weapon, `Sphere` knob, `Flat` palm push; `in_hand` for things carried in the hand) on `ContactRequest.grips`. Before the arm IK it turns the palm onto the shape (plus `twist`, e.g. a knob turn) and replaces that hand's IK target with the wrist that puts the palm on it; after the IK it sets the wrist and closes each finger from open by bisection until it touches (`FINGER_R`), then squeezes. Curl axes, palm centre / normal measured from the rest skeleton

name: `motion/bvh.rs`
summary: BVH donors: `assets/anim/cmu/*.bvh` (67 CMU mocap takes, `tools/cmu/subset.py`) → one `DonorLib` per take (frame one, the cgspeed T-pose, is the bind), library `cmu`, retargeted by `retarget::Mode::Cmu` (`CMU_MAP`)

name: `motion/compose.rs`
summary: **Only bone writer**: layers → springs → body → contact → bone `Transform`s; also publishes the pose in model space as `RigPose`

name: `motion/tweak.rs`
summary: F2 pose tweak: freeze the player on a track key (PgUp/PgDn track, [ ] key), click or , . a bone, arrows swing (camera axes), wheel twists, Shift fine, Backspace reset, Ctrl+S merges into `poses.json` `edits` (hot-reloaded); player input is ignored while it is on

name: `play/mod.rs`
summary: Shared types: `Intent Mover Action Fighter Loadout Hit StaminaSpend Interactable Climbable Water Feel`, capsule consts, `spawn_character`

name: `play/world.rs`
summary: Terrain, pond, stairs, mantle boxes, climb walls, props, interactables, characters

name: `play/input.rs`
summary: Keyboard/mouse/gamepad → `Intent`

name: `play/camera.rs`
summary: Orbit camera, lock-on framing, `CameraShake`

name: `play/controller.rs`
summary: Kinematic capsule (MoveAndSlide), floating support probe, steps, jump, knockback

name: `play/select.rs`
summary: **Only writer of `MotionLayers.layers`** + `ContactRequest` (incl. the `Bounce` character: step dip, its acceleration in `accel.y`, squash rhythm, idle breath)

name: `play/interact.rs`
summary: Focus, `offer` (per held tool; `requires` → head-shake refusal), radial stands, walk-in, use clips, `beat` (effect / loop landing + hitstop freeze; tool loops land when the blade stops, `Swing`), `reach` IK windows, emits `UseEffect` / `UseBeat`

name: `play/tools.rs`
summary: `Holding` + `ToolItem`: the axe on the table, left-hand pickup, hand-over to the right hand, carry/chop grips, settle on every re-parent

name: `play/voxel.rs`
summary: `VoxelGrid` (carve, split, `mesh`, `smooth_mesh`) and the shared `Lattice` + `surface_nets` mesher for any density field (each quad wound as a whole, split along its flatter diagonal)

name: `play/armor.rs`
summary: Plate armour (bascinet, one cuirass with arm holes, pauldrons of 3 concentric spherical lames, rerebraces, vambraces, cuisses, greaves: 16 plates) built at startup on the async pool, one thread per plate, from the body mesh: ray-cast profiles → designed shells (gap and thickness along the normal) → Surface Nets + UVs (cylindrical with a seam split, band, or azimuthal about the pole) + tangents + Metal049C with mips generated at load; each plate rigid, fitted per frame to the skin under it (Kabsch / Müller, warm-started; pauldron lames rotate only about the shoulder joint, so they never cut into each other); `BodyPadding` derived from the built plates; armour stand + E, plates leave one by one

name: `play/grass.rs` + `assets/shaders/grass.wgsl`
summary: Lush grass: chunked LOD blades, vertex-shader wind (gust fronts, flutter), trampling by `Mover`s, `GrassWind` (incl. a `gust` slot for wind magic)

name: `play/items.rs`
summary: Item entities (log, stick, stone, apple): physics drops on `Phys::Debris`, magnet flight into the bag, hill scatter + respawn spots

name: `play/inventory.rs`
summary: `Inventory` (required by `Player`, 20 stacks), I-key bag panel, pickup toasts

name: `play/trees.rs`
summary: Voxel trees drawn smooth: notch carving on `UseBeat`, chips/shake/recoil/sound, felling into a `Phys::Debris` body, landing, breaking into logs/sticks/apples, regrow; `chop` / `fell` / `drop` log lines

name: `play/fx.rs`
summary: `Burst` particles (chips, leaves) and `Sfx` one-shot sounds (first audio in the game)

name: `play/hud/`
summary: Prompt (F), log, minimap with a STATS rim button, vitals (HP ST / BW MP), hotbar (Q art, E spell, weapon in hand, bag), `stats_page` (tabs STATS, ARTS & MAGIC and SKILLS; K; `GB_STATS=<tab>` smoke hook)

name: `play/deeds.rs`
summary: `Deed { who, kind, tag, amount }`: the only input to progression. Producers: combat (hit, block, parry, kill), magic (cast, cast_hit), ranged (shoot, shoot_hit), traverse (swim / climb per metre, mantle), parkour (land Roll / Hard), trees (chop, fell); `skills` turns `ItemCollected` into gather

name: `play/record.rs`
summary: `GB_RECORD=<dir>`: frame-locked capture (each frame advances 1/`GB_RECORD_FPS` s of game time; frames `GB_RECORD_FROM`..`GB_RECORD_TO` saved as PNGs, then quit) so slow software rendering still makes normal-speed video (`ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i f_%05d.png`)

name: `play/traits.rs` + `assets/data/traits.json`
summary: The madlib "a [temper] fighter who walks [walk] and fights [fight]": NPCs roll one word per slot (seeded by entity); walk → `motion::compose::StyleScale` (exaggeration, holds, bounce; compose and select apply it per character), temper + fight → `ai::Difficulty` shifts (clamped); the log introduces each NPC

name: `play/doors.rs`
summary: Two hinged doors west of the noticeboard (`KNOB_DOOR`, `PUSH_DOOR`): the leaf turns on its hinge post; the knob door is opened with the right hand closing round the knob, turning it and riding it as the leaf swings; the push door with both palms flat on the leaf. Usable from either face (side chosen from the nearest character, frozen within `FREEZE`); the leaf swings away from the opener; a `Door block` collider fills the doorway while shut (`ColliderDisabled` once it moves). `[door]` log lines

name: `play/sheath.rs`
summary: Melee weapons ride the body when not in use (`Sheath`, on every `Fighter`): greatsword / axe across the back (`spine_03`), katana left hip, dagger right hip (`WeaponDef.carry` overrides `default_carry`). Attack / guard / art / grab / lock-on / X draws (the hand reaches, the weapon changes hands at `DRAW_SWAP` 0.2 s); X, 8 s out of the fight or a tool in hand sheathes

name: `play/block.rs`
summary: Blocking with the weapon: while guarding, the weapon hand (`HandTargets`) puts the blade across the coming swing (`intercept`: between the fighters, at the attacker's blade height, on its side), ramping in `READY` s before the active frames. The step back on a blocked blow is in `combat` (`step_length`, walked by root motion)

name: `play/grab.rs`
summary: Command grab (G; NPCs grab a foe that keeps its guard up): reach both hands to the mark's shoulders (sphere grips), catch at 0.3 s if in front and `Melee::grabbable`, hold at arm's length swinging 1.4 rad, throw at 0.75 s on `ual2/OverhandThrow` with an unblockable `HitKind::Grab` hit (7.5 m/s: ragdoll). `[grab]` log lines

name: `play/repertoire.rs`
summary: `StrikeLibrary`: 297 forward strikes (276 punches, 21 kicks) cut from the `cmu` takes by limb-speed peaks (`segment`), each an unarmed `Attack` with its active window on the measured contact. `Repertoire` (every `Fighter`): library strikes seeded per fighter + learned moves; `combat::start_swing` swaps one in 35 % of the time. Learning: `combat::resolve` writes `Witnessed` for each melee blow reaching a fighter; the third of the same move teaches it (own tempo, ±12 % clip speed) for that moveset; the player is told in the log

name: `play/appearance.rs` (cast)
summary: Modelled looks for everyone: `cast` (name → look), `classes` (the class choice re-dresses the player, `dress_class`), `areas` (guild / village / ruins / pond styles, every choice seeded by the person's name). A look has `pieces` (`looks` extras: kasa, helm, shield...) and `scale` (Thoral 1.2). Re-dressing despawns the old parts (`Worn`); `looks::undress` takes the old pieces off. `GB_HERO=mannequin` keeps everyone on the mannequin

name: `play/hall.rs`
summary: The Guild Hall complex on the flat terrace east of the courtyard (`world::TERRACE_*`, `terrace_distance`): a gate and path, a stone hall (west door, north door to the yard, pitched roof, plank floor, sconces) with swinging double doors (`Door`: open for anyone near, no collider), the front desk and ledger shelves, an indoor bounty board, the lodging (3 `bed`s, a table, 2 chairs), and the fenced training ground with the duel ring, dummies and a weapon rack

name: `play/beam.rs`
summary: Balance beams: a grounded player standing on a `Beam` balances (`Balancing`): the stick walks along it (slowly) and its sideways part counters an inverted-pendulum sway (drift grows with speed, shrinks with the Balance skill); `select::Posture` leans the torso and narrows the stance, both arms reach out through `HandTargets`; past the wobble line the arms windmill, past the fall line you topple off. Deeds `balance` (per m), `beam` crossed / fell. `GB_BEAM=steady

name: `play/aim.rs`
summary: Aiming helpers: `ballistic` (launch direction that lands a shot under gravity), `lead` (aim where a moving target will be), `Velocities` (every mover's velocity per frame). Used by `ranged` and `magic`; the player's aim point is a crosshair raycast (`input`)

name: `play/senses.rs`
summary: Enemy detection: sight (cone, world blocks rays) and the player's aura as a magnet (`AuraPresence.power` pulls the enemy's fan of sense rays; captured only at `CAPTURE` pull, still blocked by objects); `Awareness` rises/decays/forgets; `ai` picks the player only once alerted. `Veiled` hushes the aura; `sneak` deeds. Vision volumes = procedural cone meshes with the wind-aura shader

name: `play/debug.rs`
summary: Debug toggles: F12 list, 1–0 / Shift+1–3 flip 13 views (vision volumes, sense rays, aura radius, awareness, AI intent, IK targets, grass, balance tilt, projectile trails, wind shell, alt skin shader, ground layers, hide model pieces); `GB_DEBUG=1,2,4`

name: `play/wind_aura.rs` + `assets/shaders/wind_aura.wgsl`
summary: Wind-aura material (fresnel shell with wind-combed streaks); every Aura Ward gets a wind shell and bends the grass outward (`GrassWind.gust`)

name: `play/skin.rs` + `assets/shaders/skin.wgsl`
summary: Every character's skinned body gets its own extended material: ink look (toon bands, ink silhouette, shadow hatching), per-character shadow accent, and for enemies a presence rim warming with awareness plus a white blink + eye glint when alerted

name: `play/looks.rs`
summary: Character looks by name: model height/breadth, accent, bone-attached procedural pieces (kasa, hood, topknot, headband, scarf, sash, pauldrons, pouch) with spring tails

name: `play/ground.rs` + `assets/shaders/ground.wgsl`, `weather.wgsl`
summary: Terrain material (macro drifts, triplanar rock strata, grass breakup, worn paths from vertex alpha); stone/wood props weathered (moss, grime streaks, wear specks)

name: `play/ruins.rs`
summary: The ruins on the north hill (raised plateau `world::RUINS_*`): torii, pillar ring, arches, broken wall, flagstones, arena ring, dais (future boss), stone lanterns, banners, rubble; footpath from the courtyard

name: `play/horse.rs`
summary: Procedural horse under a rider (child of the rider root): barrel, neck, head, mane, tail, two-part legs with hooves, saddle and barding; trot gait by distance travelled; `select::Mounted` seats the rider (seated clip on the lower body, no foot IK) and `seat` lifts the model until the pelvis sits on the saddle

name: `play/boss.rs`
summary: Thoral, the Iron Rider: first boss on the ruins dais (huge, mounted, shield + helm from `looks`, sword); senses gate him; charge + trample (`Hit` → block/parry or be flung); boss bar; bounty 250 (`guild.json`); returns 120 s after a defeat; `GB_THORAL=1` smoke

name: `play/waypoint.rs`
summary: Compass strip at the top (cardinals + a marker to the goal: the ruins while Thoral stands, the guild desk while his bounty waits) and shrines (courtyard, below the torii): F to rest (whole again) and make it your return point (`Revive.home`). `GB_REST=1` smoke

name: `play/class.rs`
summary: Class choice on a new game (keys 1–3): Blade (katana, Flash Step), Arcanist (dagger, Frost Bloom + Storm Lance), Hunter (bow, Veil); sets weapon, skills, abilities and bindings, three attribute points. Input held and nobody attacks while choosing. Smoke runs skip it; `GB_CLASS=…` picks, `GB_CLASS_MENU=1` shows it

name: `play/talk.rs`
summary: Talking to `Talkable` NPCs: F (as `Intent.talk_pressed` when one is in focus) → `Talking`; the camera eases into the player's eyes and frames the NPC's face (first person, body hidden, 42° lens); a dialogue panel with numbered options (keys 1–7 / click); `Dialogue` written by `guild`; `GB_TALK=<name>`

name: `play/guild.rs` + `assets/data/guild.json`
summary: The guild's people (Mira the receptionist, Captain Varro, adventurers Kael and Sena: `Civilian`s with routines, chatter you overhear), `Purse` gold, Mira's desk (turn in contracts for gold + XP, the Guild Card appraisal, selling items, bounties by victim name, rank applications, beds that sleep you to dawn), and the rank exam: a sparring duel with Varro in the ring (yield at 15 % hp or a ring-out); `GB_GOLD`, `GB_CARD`, `GB_EXAM`

name: `play/sky.rs`
summary: Day/night: `Clock` (a day per 24 game minutes, start 09:00, `GB_HOUR`, F9 +1 h) moves the sun (east 06:00 → west 18:00) and a fainter, cooler moon at night; light colour warms at dawn / dusk; sky, fog and ambient follow; the minimap readout shows the time

name: `play/occupations.rs` + `assets/data/occupations.json`
summary: Civilians at work: a `Civilian` (no brain fights it, it fights no one) with an `Occupation` routine of interactable kinds: walk to the nearest free one, press interact like the player (`interact` walks it in and plays the clip), stay on looping uses, move on. A Smith (anvil, well, chair, torch) and a Farmer (seed, water, harvest, well, noticeboard)

name: `play/contracts.rs` + `assets/data/contracts.json`
summary: 12 contract templates; objectives are deed patterns × count (kills are tagged with the victim's name, so "Defeat the Rival" works); 3 open on the `Board`; finished → `stats::GrantXp`, log, next template; stats page WORK tab

name: `play/insignia.rs`
summary: Title badge: a small glowing diamond on the left breast of anyone with a title, coloured by the newest title (hue from its id), placed each frame from the chest bone (`spine[2]`) and the body's facing

name: `assets/data/titles.json`
summary: 12 titles (Blade Adept, Duelist, Slayer, Bulwark, Aura Master, Pyromancer, Frostweaver, Stormcaller, Spellblade, Wallrunner, Tidewalker, Woodsman): `requires {skills: level, deeds: lifetime count}`, flat `bonus`; earned in `skills::earn`, shown on the SKILLS tab

name: `play/skills.rs` + `assets/data/skills.json`
summary: Use-based skills (lane C): 16 rows (`SkillBook`), RuneScape curve 1–99, XP capped per skill per 30 s window; undiscovered skills build affinity and roll `base·a/(a+4)` with a pity floor (per-character seeded); arts and spells are discovered once their skills reach the `unlocks` levels; `Sheet` (required by `Fighter`) for player and NPCs; skill levels → `stats::SkillBonus`

name: `play/stats.rs`
summary: Universal `Stats` on every `Fighter` (level, Vigor Endurance Strength Dexterity Intelligence Faith, points, xp) → `Derived` (max hp / stamina / poise / magicules / Battlewill, might, spell, regen, cast speed); kills give the player xp, levels give points (`SpendPoint`)

name: `play/armory.rs`
summary: Weapon chest: opening the courtyard chest shows the weapon rack; a click sends `combat::Equip`

name: `play/vfx.rs`
summary: `bevy_hanabi` effects per element (trail, burst, cast motes, shock debris) with procedural sprites and per-particle motion algorithms (ABC flow fire, Vogel phyllotaxis frost, vortex arcane), plus CPU meshes (fractal midpoint-displacement lightning with branches, aura crescent, shock ring), impacts with glow and light flash; `GB_VFX_TEST` rig

name: `play/surfaces.rs`
summary: CPU-generated tileable detail + normal maps (ground, stone, rock, wood, metal, cloth, sand) with mip chains; `world_uvs` box-projects world-scale UVs (`PROP_TILE` 1.5 m) and generates tangents; terrain UVs are (x, z) / `TERRAIN_TILE` (3 m)

name: `play/tuning.rs`
summary: F1 live tuning panel (Exaggeration 0.9–1.4, Arm swing 0–2, Bounce 0–2), F5 saves `profiles/feel.json`

name: `play/monitor.rs`
summary: F4 joint-relation monitor + `staging/relations.log`

name: `play/parkour.rs`
summary: Graded landings: soft / momentum roll / hard land (`Owner::Move`); logs `land_*` lines

name: `play/moveset.rs`
summary: Moveset JSON schema + loader (`assets/anim/movesets/*.json`); `WeaponDef.mesh_rotation_deg` / `mesh_offset` orient glTF weapon meshes so the blade runs along the root's +Y

name: `play/combat.rs`
summary: Melee FSM (light chains, charged heavy, sprint attack, air plunge, guard / parry, roll / sidestep, stamina, poise), swept hit tests, **only `Hit` resolver**, hitstop, reactions, death / revive, weapon in the hand

name: `play/ai.rs`
summary: Rule-based NPC brain → `Intent` (no network, no language model): spacing to `combat::reach`, circle-strafe, attacks in reach, reads the foe's `Melee::tell` to guard, parry late or dodge, retreats when hurt, walks home; `Difficulty` knob; `enroll` inserts `DamageScale` + `Revive`

name: `play/ragdoll.rs`
summary: Impact ragdoll (F6 on the player): on `RagdollRequest` (combat above `Feel.ragdoll_threshold`, or F6 on the player) 11 jointed `Phys::Ragdoll` capsules spawn at the bones, limits centred on the pose at the hit; read back into a raw full-body `Source::Pose`, the root follows the pelvis; settled → stand on the ground facing the feet, `ual2/LayToIdle` get-up (`Owner::Ragdoll`); corpses stay ragdolled until combat revives them; a new request kicks the segments again

name: `play/ranged.rs`
summary: Movesets of kind `ranged` (`bow`, `crossbow`, `knives`, from the chest): RMB aims (upper-body aim clip, half speed, crosshair), LMB fires; the bow draws (hold, power grows with the draw), the crossbow reloads, knives throw in fans of 3. Shots arc under gravity, sweep body capsules, emit `Hit` (`HitKind::Projectile`, × might); arrows and bolts stick in the world; `GB_SHOOT` hook

name: `play/magic.rs`
summary: Arts (Q, **Battlewill**: built by landing / taking melee blows, trickles back) and spells (E, **magicules**: regen after a pause; MB5 cycles the bound spell). `ABILITIES` table: 5 arts (Crescent Edge, Flash Step, Aura Bullet, Earthbreaker, Aura Ward) and 4 spells (Cinder Bolt, Frost Bloom, Storm Lance, Orbit Motes), cast windows from measured clip peaks; shapes Bolt / Crescent / Quake / Lance (chains) / Orbs (Lissajous, homing) / Step / Ward (a shell that turns aside 60 % of damage and poise for 5 s; spinning gyroscope bands); mastery per landed blow → **Mastered** (cheaper, faster, stronger, bigger effects) at a permanent magicule cost; known = discovered (`skills::Sheet::abilities`); `GB_CAST` demo hook

name: `play/traverse.rs`
summary: Swim (chest under the surface, bob, sprint costs stamina, wade out; **dive** with C toward the floor while 12 s of breath last, Space surfaces; `dive` deeds train Swimming; `GB_DIVE` hook), wall climb (jump at a tall `Climbable` face; stick climbs / shimmies; hand and foot holds on a grid; jump kicks off, dodge lets go, stamina runs out → fall), **ledge hang** at the top (hands on the edge, sideways edges along it, down drops back, jump or 0.5 s of pushing up pulls over), mantle over the top, vault onto waist-high blocks (`ActionKind::Mantle`, scripted rise-then-over path); `GB_CLIMB` smoke hook

engine model space (+X the body's left, +Y up, +Z forward):

  lean, pitch          chest line (pelvis -> spine_03) off vertical, signed as asked
  shoulder_diff        left minus right shoulder height (m)
  com_offset           the pelvis/spine/head mean against the foot midpoint (lateral, forward)
  feet
